title: MOTERVA mission-event wire envelope (contract v1)
description: The ONLY shape an external physical source may submit to mission-event ingestion (issue #9). Strict: unknown keys are rejected. No field is free text; every string is an id, enum word, ISO-8601 UTC timestamp or 64-hex digest. Typed observations are validated against the closed kind/unit/value table in observation-kinds.v1.json. An event carries NO financial authority: banking vocabulary anywhere in a string field rejects the whole event, and accepted events journal under topic 'operational' only. Coordination: issue #8 (planner, Agent A) consumes the normalized form (same shape minus source.signature).

eventId.description: Source-assigned unique event identity. Duplicate submission of the same id is rejected idempotently (DUPLICATE_EVENT).

sequence.description: Strictly contiguous per (missionId, assetId, sourceId) stream, and the FIRST event of a stream must be sequence 1. First-ever sequence >1, gaps (lost updates) and regressions all fail closed (SEQUENCE_GAP / SEQUENCE_REGRESSION); admission is re-verified journal-authoritatively inside a BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction so concurrent service instances cannot both admit the same sequence.

observedAt.description: When the physical world was measured. Must be <= ingestedAt and within the freshness policy (default 15 min) at arrival. Planning eligibility (planningValid in the replay view) is TRUE ONLY while the event is fresh (< 15 min old at read time); stale/expired events remain visible as journal history only.

ingestedAt.description: When the source emitted the event. Must not be in the future beyond the clock tolerance (default 2 min).

keyId.description: Identifies the registered HMAC key. Unregistered keys are UNAUTHENTICATED_SOURCE; the signature is HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical JSON of the envelope minus source.signature.

provenance.description: SYNTHETIC labels simulated sources explicitly. An authenticated source is NOT a verified physical measurement; FIELD claims must match the source registration (PROVENANCE_MISMATCH otherwise).

observations.description: Typed (kind, unit, value) readings. Kind appears at most once per event (CONFLICTING_OBSERVATIONS). Values: integers for counts/percent; exact decimal strings for physical measures (floats are forbidden — canonical digests require integers); enum words for states/categories. See observation-kinds.v1.json.
